column1: # The fixtures the harness explores, one per line, tab-separated.
# fixture: the .l4 file, relative to jl4/examples/explore/
# labels: the design whose rows in labels.tsv name its acts
# reference: the vendored reference LTS it must be bisimilar to, relative to jl4/examples/explore/, or - for none
# until: the clock bound given to l4 explore --until (the closing deadline; see brief/README.md, "What the explorer must know" 2)
# variants: the fairness assumptions it is explored and emitted under (see variants in harness.py)
